test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 11 Oct 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: What will be the compound interest on a sum of ₹ 22,500 at the rate of 16% per annum for 1 year, when interest is compounded half yearly?
solution:
**Given:**

Sum = Rs. 22,500

Rate = 16%

Time = 1 year 

**Concept used:**

When the sum is compounded half-yearly, then the rate of interest becomes half and time becomes double.

**Formula used:**

A = P(1 + R/100)T

CI = (A – P)

**Calculation:**

R = 16/2 = 8%

T = 2 &a
